_comment: ReXGradient-160K — 273,004 chest X-rays from 160,000 studies / 109,487 patients across 79 U.S. medical sites, distributed via HuggingFace by rajpurkarlab. Three splits: train (140K studies / 238,968 images / 95,716 patients), validation (10K / 17,007 / 6,964), public test (10K / 17,029 / 6,807). Images are PNG (downsampled to 25%). Reports come pre-segmented into Indication / Comparison / Findings / Impression. No structured pathology labels. Bounding boxes exist for ~398 interstitial-pattern examples (skipped in this integration). Per-study CSVs ship alongside per-image JSONs; the JSONs are the source of truth because they expand to one entry per image (the CSV is one row per study).

primary_csv._comment: Per-image JSON keyed by study id (e.g. 'pPATIENTID_aACCESSION_sSTUDYUID'); each value contains an ImagePath LIST of all images in that study plus parallel lists for ImageViewPosition/ImageShape/ImageModality/ImageBodyPart. Harmonizer explodes by ImagePath to one row per image. We use JSON not CSV because the CSV is one row per study with no image path information. Per-split files live in metadata/ alongside the CSVs.

patient_id._comment: Direct field in each JSON entry (and the first directory component under deid_png/).

study_id._comment: Direct field in each JSON entry.

image_path._comment: Per-image relative path constructed by stripping the JSON entry's '../deid_png/' prefix. JSON ImagePath entries look like '../deid_png/<PatientID>/<AccessionNumber>/studies/<StudyUID>/series/<SeriesUID>/instances/<SopUID>.png'; after stripping, the path is rooted at base_image_dir.
image_path.derivation: From JSON ImagePath list (one entry per image); strip leading '../deid_png/' so the relative path joins cleanly to base_image_dir.

labels._comment: ReXGradient ships NO structured pathology labels — only free-text reports (Indication / Comparison / Findings / Impression). Set LABEL_COLS = [] and gate output_cls=True with a clear error. Future work: derive CheXbert/CheXpert-style labels offline from reports.

view_position._comment: Per-image ImageViewPosition list inside each JSON entry — same length as ImagePath. Values: 'PA', 'AP', 'LATERAL', 'UNKNOWN', or null. Harmonizer reads it inline; no separate CSV.

bboxes._comment: metadata/interstitial_pattern_bbox.json contains ~398 Label-Studio-format boxes (x/y/width/height in original pixel coords, label = 'Reticulonodular' or similar interstitial-pattern subtypes). Out of scope for the v1 integration — adding it later requires normalising by the original ImageShape (post-downsample dims live in the per-image JSON's ImageShape list) and joining on the synthetic '<study_id>_<sop_uid>.png' key used by the bbox file.

reports._comment: Reports are inline in the JSON (and the CSV) as four columns: Indication, Comparison, Findings, Impression. Harmonizer concatenates them with section headers into a single 'report' string per row (one report shared across all images of the same study) and overrides _build_report to skip the base file-reading path.

extra_init_params._comment: No extra params required — the harmonizer takes csv_path (the JSON path) and base_image_dir like other 2D harmonizers.

custom_preprocessing: Use JSON not CSV (CSV is per-study; JSON has the per-image ImagePath list needed to explode rows). Concatenate Indication+Comparison+Findings+Impression with section headers into the 'report' column. Three split-specific subclasses (ReXGradientTrain/Valid/Test) wrap the base class so saved harmonizers round-trip to the right class — mirrors the CheXpert train/valid pattern.
